addItemBehavior.consequence: Server-side add_item can retain an item beyond nominal bag capacity; V5 must not rely on overflow as normal outputspace.

canAddItem.trueWhen: at least one nominal empty slot exists OR compatible stack can accept the item
canAddItem.use: preflight guard used by synchronous value-changing handlers

canAddItems.consequence: Dismantle can conservatively reserve capacity for all potential outputs before mutation.

inventoryInsertion.v5Rule: Every planned transformation computes a conservative post-mutation outputspace proof before send. Server overflow is emergency evidence to reconcile, not a planned capacity mechanism.

startValidation: exchange definition and drop table exist

startOutputspace.serverRule: When player.esize<=0 and input stack quantity is not exactly 1, reject inventory_full before mutation.
startOutputspace.consequence: Even if def.e would fully consume a stack larger than one, current server source still rejects at zero free slots.
startOutputspace.placeholderReservation: After consuming def.e, server adds one placeholder item and stores its slot in q.exchange.num.

mutationStart: consume massexchange/mass exchange plus condition when present
create q.exchange with drop id, input name, consumed quantity and placeholder slot
exchange.timing: hardcore 400ms; otherwise 3000..5999ms random; massexchange halves and massexchangepp divides by ten.
completion: clear placeholder at recorded slot if still present
resolve drop table via server exchange(player,dropId,args)
reward can affect inventory, gold, shells, account cosmetics, nothing, or recursively another drop table
item reward is inserted using generic add_item and may stack into another slot rather than q.exchange.num
exchange.multiOutputSpecialCase: sixcake adds three anniversarygift items after its selected drop and may additionally add a rare cxjar; generic add_item retains overflow if capacity is insufficient.

publicWrapper.behavior: Waits while character.q.exchange or recorded placeholder remains, up to about 30 seconds, and rejects on disconnect/timeout.
publicWrapper.returns: {success:true,reward:name,num} where name is whatever item is found in the recorded placeholder slot after completion, if any.
publicWrapper.limitation: The wrapper return is not a complete reward ledger. Stackable rewards may merge into another slot; gold/shells/cosmetics/empty have no item name; recursive/special rewards may affect multiple domains.

recovery.rule: Promise reward/num is supporting evidence only. Commit requires full reward-domain reconciliation against the pinned drop-table contract.

exchangeBuy.clientSelection: item_position(token) chooses a token inventory slot; wrapper sends the entire observed token stack q as data.q.
exchangeBuy.optimisticGuard: Server requires current item.q == data.q; mismatch returns safety_check.
pricing: price < 1 means one token produces q=parseInt(1/price) output quantity
price >= 1 consumes exactly configured token quantity
reward names containing '-' can encode item.data
outputspace: If token stack is not fully consumed, server requires can_add_item(output) before mutation.
If token stack is exactly consumed, the freed token slot is sufficient and no separate free slot is required.
exchangeBuy.recovery: Fresh exact token-stack delta plus output item/data/quantity is settlement evidence; data.q is a stack-version safety value, not requested purchase quantity.

normalCraft.protocol: Client sends up to nine [gridPosition,inventoryIndex] entries; server derives recipe from sorted item names/levels via D.craftmap.
normalCraft.quantityModel: For each current recipe ingredient name, server expects the required quantity in the selected single stack. quantity/place maps are keyed by ingredient name.
normalCraft.driftRule: If a future normal recipe introduces duplicate ingredient names, craft is quarantined until protocol semantics are revalidated.
normalCraft.autoCraft: Client scans from inventory index 0 and chooses the first unlocked/unblocked/non-giveaway stack with matching name/level and enough quantity for each recipe ingredient.
outputspace: If any selected ingredient stack is consumed completely, server treats that as one freed output slot.
Otherwise server requires can_add_item(output) before mutation.
outputProperties: non-misc input property p values are collected and one may be randomly inherited by output
add_item is called with r:1, so upgrade/compound outputs can independently receive rare shiny property through add_item logic

anniversaryCraft.route: If resolved recipe.quest == 'anniversary_baker', normal handler delegates to anniversary_craft.
anniversaryCraft.trustedPlanning: Server ignores the client-provided quantity claims after recipe identification and planCraft scans the full live inventory against the trusted recipe.
anniversaryCraft.multiStackSupport: planCraft can satisfy one recipe requirement across multiple eligible stacks and accumulates exact take per inventory index.
anniversaryCraft.itemEligibility: name, optional level, unlocked, unblocked, not giveaway
anniversaryCraft.outputspace: If any planned input stack is fully consumed, that freed slot is sufficient; otherwise can_add_item(output) must succeed.
anniversaryCraft.outputSpecial: recipe.output may override output name/data, e.g. makeawishjar -> cxjar with data='makeawish'.

leveledCompoundPath.trigger: item exists, item.level is truthy, and item definition compound=true
leveledCompoundPath.outputspace: requires player.esize >= 2 before mutation; consuming one input then adding three outputs is net +2 slots
leveledCompoundPath.notableServerBehavior: This special branch executes before the normal locked/blocked checks.
leveledCompoundPath.v5Policy: V5 is stricter: locked or blocked/giveaway/value-protected items are denied even if server special branch would accept them.
leveledCompoundPath.propertyLoss: Special outputs are reconstructed from name/level/grace; arbitrary original item property p is not copied by this branch.

definitionPath.outputspace: Before mutation, can_add_items is run against pseudo-items for every possible dismantle output, counting one freed slot if the input quantity is exactly one.
definitionPath.probabilisticOutputs: Entries with quantity/probability <1 may be skipped by random roll; preflight nevertheless reserves capacity conservatively for them.
definitionPath.propertyPropagation: Non-misc input p is copied to produced items through add_item p argument.

dismantle.recovery: Because both paths are synchronous but non-idempotent, UNKNOWN reconciles exact input identity, gold cost and all possible outputs; no same-intent retry.

v5Policy.exchangeOutputspace: Compute a conservative bounded reward-domain/output-slot requirement from the pinned D.drops graph. If the graph cannot be bounded or has drifted, deny automation until revalidated.
v5Policy.atomicTransforms: Craft, exchange_buy and dismantle must prove server-equivalent preflight capacity before send.
v5Policy.inventoryIndexRule: All physical inventory indexes are re-resolved from pinned identities immediately before execution; stale numeric indexes do not carry authority.
v5Policy.postconditionRule: Commit from full inventory/value/account-domain deltas, never solely from Promise output slot/name.

invariants: Generic add_item overflow is never used as a planned V5 capacity strategy.
Every transformation proves conservative outputspace before send.
Exchange q/placeholder proves accepted in-flight mutation after input consumption.
Exchange Promise reward/num is not a complete reward ledger.
Exchange settlement observes inventory, gold, shells, cosmetics and empty outcome domains allowed by the pinned drop table.
Recursive exchange drop graphs must be bounded and version-pinned before automated execution.
Every exchange follow-up after UNKNOWN reconciles the original input and all reward domains; no same-intent retry.
exchange_buy pins exact physical token stack and its entire observed q because server safety_check compares that value.
Normal craft inputs are exact physical stacks and current recipes contain no duplicate ingredient names; recipe drift introducing duplicates quarantines craft.
Normal auto_craft server protocol requires each current ingredient quantity in one selected stack.
Anniversary craft is a separate trusted server-planned path that may consume one requirement across multiple stacks.
Craft gold/input/output mutation remains one synchronous settlement domain.
Leveled compound dismantle is a special three-output path requiring net two extra slots.
V5 denies locked/blocked/value-protected leveled compound dismantle even though the server special path precedes normal lock/block checks.
Normal dismantle outputspace is computed conservatively across all possible probabilistic outputs.
No physical inventory index is reused without fresh identity resolution immediately before send.
